observations: The console has a three-tier chassis, which is the physical design of the PlayStation 4 Pro.
The 'PS4' logo is visible on the front right of the console in photo 0.
The text 'STAR WARS' is printed on the front lower lip.
A large Galactic Empire emblem is visible on the top surface of the console.
Two black wireless controllers are present.
One UK-style power cable and one HDMI cable are included.
The console appears to be the Star Wars Battlefront II Limited Edition.

claims.evidence: The three-tier hardware design and 'PS4' logo in photo 0 are exclusive to the Pro model.
Internal performance and frame rates cannot be verified from a static image.
